description: Use for any question about open trips or day outs to join: by city slug, month (YYYY-MM), kind (trip or dayout), budget tier or mood. Each hook carries its public TripHook page (url) and, for a day out, the What's on page (event_page). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · Find a crew". Public fields only, never a person. For any where should I go, where is warm or budget question, use search_destinations instead.

city.description: City slug, e.g. "lisbon" (list_cities / /api/public/cities return the slugs).
